name: – Ilhan Kyuchyuk – § 54 – Am 16
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text: 54. Welcomes the strengthening of people-to-people contacts, student, academic, scientific, cultural and other professional exchanges, notably in the fields of education, business and tourism; notes that the EPCA includes the possibility of negotiating a readmission agreement; rejects any visa facilitation arrangement that could lead to increased illegal migration or place additional burden on the EU’s asylum system;
